subject.title: Provider Exclusion List Project
details: Provider Exclusion List Project: Downloaded OIG LEIE (List of Excluded Individuals/Entities) CSV file from the official HHS OIG website.
Imported 83,464 exclusion records into SQLite database using Python.
Designed database schema with fields: last_name, first_name, business_name, npi, state, city, address, specialty, exclusion_type, exclusion_date, reinstatement_date, waiver_date, waiver_state.
Added indexes on searchable fields (last_name, npi, state, city) for fast queries.
Built Django web interface integrated with existing Bookstore project.
Implemented search functionality by: name, business name, NPI, state, and city.
Display results with badges distinguishing individuals from organizations.
Created ERD diagram for database documentation.

notes: OIG LEIE is the official federal database of excluded healthcare providers.
Organizations cannot receive payment from Federal health care programs if excluded.
Data is updated monthly by OIG.
Search results show exclusion type and date.
Django app is accessible at /exclusion/ path.
